svg.title: Home FIX conversation flow
svg.desc: From welcome and language choice, through the before photo, the installation, the serial label check and confirmation, the four compliance photos, a signal drop and submission, to the review outcomes: approved, retake or needs assistance. A person can be reached from any step.
